info.album: Celebrate: The Three Dog Night Story, 1965–1975

podcast.body: This song was one of three number one hits for Three Dog Night. "Including three number ones, black and white in 1972, joy to the world in 1971, and their very first number one, also the very first number one on American top 40, Mama told me not to come."

srcs.episode: Ep. 39 - American Top 40 - Keeping Our Feet on the Ground and Reaching for the Stars (Part 1)

podcast.body: This song was the Billboard year-end number one for 1971, described as a "near accident" for the LA band. Its songwriter hadn't finished the lyrics, and the line "Jeremiah was a bullfrog" was not intended to be the final opening. A DJ discovered it buried at the end of a Three Dog Night album. It spent six weeks at number one and gained generational familiarity through its inclusion in the 1983 movie "The Big Chill." "its songwriter hadn't finished the lyrics that bit about Jeremiah being a bullfrog wasn't even supposed to be the final opening long."
